fields.label: Customer
fields.description: The client this job is for. Must already exist as a Customer, or be created first.

fields.label: Product Estimation Template
fields.description: Pick a template (Folding Carton, Business Card, Sticker...) to pull in the right cost items automatically - like choosing a BOM. You can still add or remove individual items for this one job afterward without touching the template itself.

fields.label: Finished Width (cm)
fields.description: The flat, printed piece's own size, in centimetres - matching how you'd naturally give it (e.g. 51). Not the sheet size, and not the closed/folded size for a box - the flat blank as it sits on the press sheet.

fields.label: Finished Height (cm)
fields.description: See Finished Width - same effect, the other dimension.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: How many finished pieces the customer wants. Drives Sheets Required, and therefore every quantity-based Cost Item. To quote several quantities at once, add extra rows under "Additional Quantities to Quote" below instead of changing this field repeatedly.

fields.label: Print Enquiry
fields.description: Auto-filled when this estimate was created from an enquiry via "Convert to Estimate". Leave blank for an estimate started directly.

fields.label: Markup on Cost %
fields.description: Added to the total cost to produce the selling price. For example, 10% means Total Cost × 1.10. This is markup, not gross-margin percentage.

fields.label: Product Type
fields.description: Set automatically from the Template picked above - used for reporting only.

fields.label: Colours Front
fields.description: Number of ink colours printed on the front (e.g. 4 for full-colour CMYK). Drives the Plate Cost Item.

fields.label: Colours Back
fields.description: Only the EXTRA distinct colours the back needs its own plates for. Leave at 0 whenever the back reuses the same colour set as the front (the normal case for a 4-colour process job printed both sides, e.g. Work and Turn) - that's a Plate Cost question, separate from whether the job is double-sided at all, which is the checkbox below.

fields.label: Printed on Both Sides
fields.description: Confirmed real gap (Talha, 2026-08-19): this is INDEPENDENT of Colours Back above - a job can reuse the same 4 plates on both sides (Colours Back = 0) while still needing the sheet run through the press twice. Tick this whenever the job is double-sided, regardless of the Colours Back value. Doubles the effective sheet count fed into the Printing Cost Item's tier lookup (and can shift it into a cheaper tier, since it's a declining-rate table) - confirmed missing on the first real double-sided flyer job, where leaving this unticked silently undercounted Printing.

fields.label: Paper Type
fields.description: Pick the real paper stock and weight from the list - the rate is already set up behind this.

fields.label: Sheet Size
fields.description: Which standard stock sheet this job is planned on.

fields.label: Press
fields.description: Which machine runs this job.

fields.label: Use a Different Waste Allowance
fields.description: Leave unticked to use the selected press's normal waste allowance. Tick only when the estimator has chosen a different allowance for this job, including 0%.

fields.label: Waste Allowance for This Job (%)
fields.description: Enter the agreed waste percentage for this job. Enter 0 when no additional running waste should be included.

fields.label: ⚙️ Adjust Calculated Sheet Plan (optional)
fields.description: First review Ups per Sheet and Sheets Required above. Open this only when production has confirmed a different imposition or exact sheet quantity.

fields.label: Sheets Required Override
fields.description: Leave blank to calculate Sheets Required from Ups + waste %, as usual. Set this instead when the estimator gives an exact sheet count directly (e.g. '3333 sheets') rather than a percentage to calculate from - Paper Cost recomputes automatically from this number, so the two stay consistent. Takes priority over Waste % Override above when both are set.

fields.label: Override Ups per Sheet
fields.description: Tick when the geometric calculation doesn't match real practice for this job - e.g. a press reserves one position for a control strip, or the estimator's own number differs for a reason the formula can't see. Confirmed real: a 21x29.7cm flyer on a 70x100cm sheet computes 9-up geometrically, but Mofeed's real practice is 8-up - not fully explained by margins alone.

fields.label: Ups per Sheet Override
fields.description: Only used when 'Override Ups per Sheet' above is ticked. Sheets Required recomputes from this number automatically, same as the normal calculated Ups value would.

fields.label: Why This Override?
fields.description: A short note for whoever looks at this estimate later - e.g. 'Mofeed's real number for this sheet/size, one position reserved for a control strip'.

fields.label: Finishing & Delivery
fields.description: Confirm only the finishing decisions needed for this job. Detailed production cost lines are available in the optional section below.

fields.label: Die for This Job
fields.options:
New die required
Use existing die
fields.description: Choose New die required when a die must be made and charged for this job. Choose Use existing die only when the exact die for this design is already available; no new-die charge will be added.

fields.label: Charge Die Using Full Sheet Area
fields.description: Normally selected: the die/frame is charged against the whole press sheet. When selected, no die width or height is needed. Clear it only when the die maker charges a smaller custom die area.

fields.label: Custom Die Width (cm)
fields.description: Only needed when the die is charged using a smaller custom area instead of the full press sheet.

fields.label: Custom Die Height (cm)
fields.description: Only needed when the die is charged using a smaller custom area instead of the full press sheet.

fields.label: Number of Glued Sides
fields.description: Enter 0 for no gluing. The normal tiered glue price is multiplied by the number of sides. If a particular job is priced differently, override the Glue row in Cost Items & Adjustments.

fields.label: Lamination Required
fields.description: Tick to include lamination in this estimate. This stays synchronized with the Lamination row in Cost Items & Adjustments and updates the calculated cost when saved.

fields.label: Use Manual Packing Cost
fields.description: Leave unticked to calculate packing from the normal carton rules. Tick when the estimator has a confirmed packing amount for this job.

fields.label: Packing Cost (SAR)
fields.description: The confirmed packing amount for this job. Any value, including 0, replaces the Packing row's normal calculation when Use Manual Packing Cost is ticked. Save to recalculate the totals.

fields.label: Reusing an existing die for this customer?
fields.description: Repeat customers don't pay for the die again - check this on a reorder of the same design.

fields.label: Freight Cost
fields.description: Delivery cost to the customer's location, if applicable. Added straight into the total.

fields.label: Cost Items & Adjustments (optional)
fields.description: Open only when you need to inspect, add, remove, enable, disable, or override an individual production cost. Click a row for all adjustment options.

fields.label: Cost Items
fields.description: Works like the Items table in a Quotation. The compact grid shows the essentials; click any row for its full options and helping text.

fields.label: Additional Quantities to Quote
fields.description: Want to offer the customer a price at 5,000 / 10,000 / 20,000 in one quotation? Add one row per extra quantity here.

fields.label: 📊 Results — everything below is calculated automatically
fields.description: Nothing below this line is entered by hand. If a number here looks wrong, the fix is always in a field above, not here.

fields.label: Sell Price
fields.description: The final quoted price for this job: Total Cost Before Markup × (1 + Markup on Cost %). This is what becomes the Quotation line.

fields.label: Ups per Sheet
fields.description: How many finished pieces fit on one press sheet.
The worked-out formula for Ups per Sheet, computed fresh each save - fed into the click-to-reveal icon on the Ups field itself via client script.

fields.label: Sheets Required
fields.description: Quantity ÷ Ups, plus make-ready and running waste.
The worked-out formula for Sheets Required, computed fresh each save.

fields.label: Other Cost Items Total
fields.description: Sum of all enabled Cost Items above. Paper is shown separately and is not included in this number.
Raw HTML, stored here so it actually persists (an HTML fieldtype alone has no database column) - the field below just displays it.

fields.options:
The calculation, step by step:

1. Paper — Sheets Required × the exact per-sheet cost from the Paper Type picked above.
2. Cost Items — every enabled row, each priced by its own rule (per colour, per cm², per 1,000 sheets or pieces, per side, or a flat fee) — summed into Cost Items Total.
3. Subtotal — Paper + Cost Items Total + Freight.
4. Sell Price — Subtotal × (1 + Margin %).
طريقة الحساب خطوة بخطوة:

١. الورق — عدد الأفرخ المطلوبة × التكلفة الدقيقة للفرخ.
٢. بنود التكلفة — كل بند مفعّل، محسوب بقاعدته الخاصة، ويُجمع في إجمالي بنود التكلفة.
٣. المجموع — الورق + إجمالي بنود التكلفة + الشحن.
٤. السعر النهائي — المجموع × (١ + نسبة الربح٪).

fields.label: Paper Cost
fields.description: Sheets Required × the exact price per sheet. Shown separately because paper is not a Cost Item row.

fields.label: Total Cost Before Markup
fields.description: Paper Cost + Other Cost Items Total + Freight. The markup percentage is applied to this amount to produce Sell Price.
